/projects/{projectId}/servers/{serverId}/conformance-runs {"post": {"operationId": "startConformanceRun", "tags": ["Conformance ru
ns"], "summary": "Start a persisted conformance run", "description": "Grades the saved server against the protocol, apps, and task
s suites and returns `202` with a run id. The target comes from the saved server the path names: a body cannot supply a URL. OAuth
is not startable here. Poll the run detail for the verdict. Status, outcome, and score are three different answers.\n\nBy default
the run uses the server's saved conformance settings: the checks they select, their tool inputs and their run time budget. The re
ceipt's `settingsSource` says what applied: `saved`, or `defaults` when the server has nothing saved. `settings: \"none\"` runs ev
ery check with no tool inputs. With saved settings, the start first checks which MCP protocol version the server speaks and leaves
out any suite with no saved checks for that version, as the app does. A retry with the same idempotency key returns the run that
key started, with its original suites and settings. A run still going at its budget ends with its unfinished suites incomplete.\n\
nOn hosted MCPJam, a user's starts past 30 in 10 minutes can be refused with `429` and `Retry-After`. A server that is restarting
also answers `429` with `Retry-After`, with `details.reason` `SERVER_DRAINING`.", "parameters": [{"$ref": "#/components/parameters
/projectId"}, {"$ref": "#/components/parameters/serverId"}, {"$ref": "#/components/parameters/launcherHeader"}, {"name": "Idempote
ncy-Key", "in": "header", "required": false, "description": "The body's `idempotencyKey` sent as a header. It wins over the body f
ield.", "schema": {"type": "string", "maxLength": 256}}], "requestBody": {"required": false, "content": {"application/json": {"sch
ema": {"type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "properties": {"suites": {"type": "array", "minItems": 1, "items": {"type"
: "string", "enum": ["protocol", "apps", "tasks"]}, "description": "Suites to run. Defaults to protocol, apps, and tasks. OAuth is
not available on this surface."}, "idempotencyKey": {"type": "string", "maxLength": 200, "description": "Deduplicates a retried P
OST for the same saved server. Mapped to a namespaced externalRunId (`api:<projectId>:<serverId>:<key>`); a keyless start always i
nserts and spends quota."}, "protocolVersion": {"type": "string", "enum": ["2025-03-26", "2025-06-18", "2025-11-25", "2026-07-28"]
, "description": "Pin one MCP protocol version. Without it the run uses the version the server negotiates."}, "engineVersion": {"t
ype": "string"}, "settings": {"type": "string", "enum": ["saved", "none"], "description": "`saved` (the default) runs the server's
saved conformance settings. `none` runs every check with no tool inputs."}}}}}}, "responses": {"202": {"description": "The run wa
s accepted and is executing.", "content": {"application/json": {"schema": {"type": "object", "required": ["runId", "projectId", "s
erverId", "status", "deduped", "requestedSuites"], "properties": {"runId": {"type": "string"}, "projectId": {"type": "string"}, "s
erverId": {"type": "string"}, "status": {"type": "string"}, "deduped": {"type": "boolean"}, "requestedSuites": {"type": "array", "
items": {"type": "string"}}, "settingsSource": {"type": "string", "enum": ["saved", "defaults", "none"], "description": "The setti
ngs the run used. `defaults` means the server has no saved settings, so every check runs."}}}}}}, "400": {"description": "The body
carried an unknown key or an unknown `protocolVersion`, named OAuth, asked only for suites the saved settings leave out, or the s
erver uses a transport conformance cannot grade."}, "401": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"}, "403": {"$ref": "#/com
ponents/responses/Forbidden"}, "404": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/NotFound"}, "409": {"description": "The server's saved tool
inputs could not be read. Save them again on the Conformance page, or start with `settings: \"none\"`."}, "429": {"$ref": "#/comp
onents/responses/RateLimited"}, "500": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/InternalError"}, "502": {"description": "The saved server'
s address could not be resolved."}}}}
/projects/{projectId}/eval-runs {"post": {"operationId": "createEvalRun", "tags": ["Eval runs"], "summary": "Create an eval run (a
sync)", "description": "Creates a suite run from an existing `suiteId` (rerun) and/or inline `tests`, then **detaches execution an
d responds `202` immediately** with the `runId`. Validation and quota errors surface on this request; poll `GET /eval-runs/{runId}
` for progress. The run appears live in the hosted UI Runs tab, tagged `source: \"api\"`.\n\nA bare `suiteId` with no inline tests
reruns the suite as configured. Per-organization concurrency is capped (default 2 concurrent runs); exceeding it returns `429` wi
th `details.reason: \"CONCURRENT_RUN_LIMIT\"`.\n\nFor a suite with attached project environments, pass `environmentId` to choose w
hich one the run uses; the `202` echoes the resolved `environment` triple, and `GET /eval-runs/{runId}` reports the same triple fo
r the life of the run.\n\nTo make the run readable as something more specific than `API` in the Runs table, send `x-mcpjam-launche
r` (and `x-mcpjam-ci` from a CI job). Both are labels: `source` is stamped `api` either way.", "parameters": [{"$ref": "#/componen

e": "echo", "args": {"args": {"text": "hi"}}}}]}]}}}}, "responses": {"202": {"description": "Run created; execution continues in t
